scope: Carry a per-record evidence role through cube v1-v4 and render a compound cell mark in the static explorer: upper case for a certified direct grade, lower case for a supporting ingredient of that kind. A coordinate supported directly by both kinds stops collapsing to the higher-ranked letter, and pieces-only cells stop hiding their ingredient mix. Additive metadata only; no status, count, or coverage value changes.

tier_0_compile.command: python3 -m py_compile on the eleven changed foundations modules

tier_0_json.command: parse every foundations JSON with json.loads

tier_1_generator_chain.result: All five generated chains byte-current after regeneration.

tier_1_independent_checkers.result: Role closure, role vocabulary, role/status agreement, role-kind-versus-registry agreement, and dual-count declarations all pass.

tier_1_headless_render.command: boot foundations/site/app.js under a DOM stub in bun and inspect the rendered grid, filters, and inspector
tier_1_headless_render.result: 576 cells render with the compound mark histogram {'·': 205, 'R': 90, 'L': 76, 'Pl': 75, 'Pr': 51, 'G': 30, 'P': 20, 'Plr': 14, 'LR': 7, 'Lr': 5, 'Rl': 3}, matching the generated counts and the checker's independent recomputation. All seven LR cells carry data-dual and the two-colour gradient. Status filters return 88 LOCAL_RESULT (L 76 + LR 7 + Lr 5), 100 LITERATURE_RESULT (R 90 + LR 7 + Rl 3), and 160 PIECES_ONLY (Pl 75 + Pr 51 + Plr 14 + P 20), so a lower-case ingredient letter never moves a cell between families. The dual-cell inspector renders three role badges, the direct-grades sentence, and two status pills.

tier_3.criterion: No freeze, tag, theorem promotion, lifecycle promotion, or shared core-algebra change applies. The change is additive display metadata whose full affected certificate chain and complete foundations suite were run.

tier_1_invariant_negative_test.command: inject a DIRECT_LOCAL role onto a PIECES_ONLY cell and re-run foundations/check_refined_intersection_cube_v4.py
tier_1_invariant_negative_test.result: The checker reports 'role/status agreement CLASSICAL_STANDARD|ALGEBRAIC_CSTAR|CAUSAL_PROPAGATION_GREEN'. Role and status are written by different passes, so v3 and v4 now assert their agreement rather than assuming it.

claim_preservation.rule: The cube canonical digests project coordinate, status, migration, and evidence fields only, so an unchanged digest proves no claim moved while the additive role field was introduced.
claim_preservation.site_digest_change_reason: The site canonical digest projects the cell array, which now carries the additive evidence_roles field. Status counts, coverage counts, evidence-record count, and every displayed number are unchanged.

mark_scheme.rule: Upper case is a certified direct grade; lower case is a supporting ingredient of that kind. A lower-case letter is suppressed when its kind already appears as an upper-case grade, and an UNREVIEWED record contributes no letter.
mark_scheme.invariant: The upper-case part of every mark equals the cell's scalar status family, verified per cell in check_matrix_site_v2.py.

claim_boundary: This change makes existing distinctions visible. It adds no evidence, no coverage, no status promotion, and no literature review. An UNREVIEWED role is not a finding that a record fails to support its cell; a dual LR mark does not compose its two records into a stronger result; and a lower-case ingredient letter is neither a grade nor a promotion. No new Lorentzian-causal claim is made.
does_not_establish: that an UNREVIEWED evidence role is an absence of direct support
that a dual LR mark composes its two records into a stronger result
that a lower-case ingredient letter is a result, a grade, or a promotion
a directness review for records the capability registry does not cover
any new coverage or status promotion
